jobs.title: IT Consultant, Applications (Business Analysis, PM, .NET Core, Data Analytics, East)
jobs.description:
IT Consultant, Applications (Business Analysis, PM, .NET Core, Data Analytics, East)

The IT Consultant is essential to ensure the relevant application services are maintained and able to support business operations. It involves gathering business requirements and evaluating business issues to develop and implement digital solutions that align with the needs of the University. The role requires collaboration with development teams, whether in-house, outsourced, or co-sourced, to produce relevant digital solutions, and coordination with stakeholders to ensure successful implementation of those solutions.

Key Responsibilities
Determine, define, and oversee the business needs of the University
Arrange and conduct system requirement meetings with end-users and stakeholders for product roadmap, and operational issues
Use relevant human-centered tools and methods to organise, create, and lead workshops so as to identify opportunities, problems and map service journeys
Develop prototypes and proof-of-concepts to test ideas and improve the chances of successful implementation
Prioritize requirements through analysing information with stakeholders and deliver functional and design specifications
Translate business requirements into technical requirements
Draft business requirements documentation and presentation slides
Identify and track issues and obstacles facing assigned projects and mitigate project risks
Prepare and review project documents to ensure they are clear, complete, and aligned with prescribe standards
Operate, support, and maintain assigned software applications, including in-house and third-party systems
Provide ongoing maintenance and support for applications, ensuring service level agreements (SLAs) are met
Manage support activities such as bug fixes, service requests, and troubleshooting

Job Requirements
Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Electronics Engineering or a related discipline
At least 6 years of relevant IT experience, including a minimum of 4 years in a technical role and 2 years of project management experience
Professional certification in Business Analysis such as the Certification of Competency in Business Analysis™ (CCBA®), Certified Business Analysis Professional™ (CBAP®) or an equivalent certification is preferred
Hands-on experience with IIS Server, Visual Studio 2016/2019, and MS SQL Server T-SQL
Experience with OutSystems, .NET Core, data analytics tools such as Microsoft Power BI, Qlik or Tableau, and robotic process automation tools such as Microsoft Power Automate or UiPath will be an advantage
Strong ability to analyze business requirements and translate them into clear technical specifications and documentation
Good technical knowledge to understand the technical constraints of solutions
Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with effective problem-solving abilities
Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders and drive outcomes to make an impact
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to pitch ideas and engage stakeholders at all levels

Interested candidates are invited to submit their MS Word formatted CV with a photo.

By submitting any application or resume to us, you will be deemed to have agreed and consented to us disclosing your personal information to prospective employers for their consideration.

We regret to inform that only short-listed applicants will be notified.

jobs.title: Principal CRM Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Description

Role Mission:

The Principal CRM Engineer defines and evolves the architecture of StarHub’s core Customer Relationship Management (CRM) and Order Management (OM) platforms that power customer onboarding, sales journeys, and fulfilment for the Consumer Business.

The role focuses on building a scalable, resilient, and future-ready CRM/OM platform, ensuring seamless end-to-end customer experiences and enabling rapid product innovation. Operating within a DevOps model, the Principal CRM Engineer drives platform modernization, architectural standardization, and system-wide reliability, while guiding engineering teams to eliminate systemic issues and scale the platform sustainably.

Responsibilities:

Define and own the end-to-end architecture of CRM/OM platforms across Customer Management, Product Catalogue, Campaigns, Order Management, and Revenue/Billing integration

Establish architectural principles and standards for microservices, API design, workflow orchestration, and data management across CRM/OM domains
Design and optimize workflow orchestration strategies for order lifecycle processes, ensuring scalability and fault tolerance
Drive platform scalability and performance improvements by identifying system bottlenecks across APIs, databases, and workflows
Define and govern data architecture, ensuring consistency, integrity, and efficient data flow across CRM, provisioning, and billing systems
Establish API and integration standards, including versioning, idempotency, and reliability patterns for internal and external system integrations
Lead platform modernization initiatives, including migration from legacy CRM systems to cloud-native CRM-based architecture
Reduce technical debt and system complexity by driving modularization, decoupling, and standardization across services
Define and implement observability and reliability strategies across the platform, ensuring proactive monitoring, alerting, and performance optimization
Collaborate with DevOps and platform teams to design scalable cloud-native solutions using Kubernetes (EKS), CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code
Act as the technical authority for design decisions, conducting architecture reviews and ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture and business objectives
Mentor CRM Engineers on system design, architectural thinking, and advanced debugging techniques
Influence cross-functional teams and stakeholders to adopt consistent engineering standards and best practices
Collaborate with Product Owners, QA, DevOps, and vendors to ensure seamless integration and delivery of end-to-end customer journeys

Qualifications

10+ years of professional software engineering experience with a strong emphasis on system architecture and large ‑ scale distributed systems
Demonstrated ability to design, evolve, and operate enterprise ‑ critical platforms, particularly within CRM, OM, BSS, or comparable domains
Deep architectural expertise across:
Microservices and distributed system design
API design, integration patterns, and service contracts
Workflow driven and orchestration-based systems
Data architecture, modelling, and database performance optimization
Strong hands-on technical experience with:
Java, Spring Boot, and RESTful API design/development
PostgreSQL and/or Oracle, including query optimization and performance tuning
Kubernetes based platforms and cloud environments (AWS preferred)
Proven experience working in telecom BSS/OSS environments, including CRM, billing, and order management systems
Established track record of leading platform modernization, large scale refactoring, and transformation initiatives in complex enterprise environments

Preferred Certifications

Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) or Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD)
AWS Certified Solutions Architect (Associate or Professional)

jobs.title: Backend Developer dotNet AWS
jobs.description:
Backend Developer dotNet and AWS

At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.

Your Role

We are looking for an experienced Backend Developer with AWS
experience who enjoys taking ownership and driving work from idea to production. You are comfortable working in a complex environment, eager to understand the business and domain, and motivated by improving both the product and the way we work.

In this role you will play a key role in:

Developing and modernizing backend services using C# and .NET 10
Designing scalable, cloud-native solutions on AWS
Building applications using Entity Framework and relational databases
Contributing to CI/CD pipelines, deployment processes and engineering best practices
Collaborating with business stakeholders, developers and architects in an international environment
Taking ownership of solutions from requirements through implementation, deployment and support

Your Profile

Strong hands-on experience with C# and .NET
Experience with Entity Framework and relational databases
Solid AWS knowledge and experience with cloud-based architectures
Experience with GitLab, CI/CD practices and modern software delivery processes
Good understanding of SOLID principles, clean code and Agile/Kanban ways of working
Ability to independently drive development activities from requirements to production support

Nice To Have

Experience with Docker and containerized applications
Experience with AWS CDK, cloud-native development and cloud migration initiatives
Experience owning and maintaining CI/CD pipelines
Experience with PostgreSQL
Experience modernizing legacy applications and architectures
Experience with WPF (.NET Framework 4.8) and CoreWCF/service-oriented architectures

What You Will Love About Working Here

Impact & Ownership:
Work on a strategically important platform used across multiple brands and countries within the TRATON Group, with the opportunity to influence technical direction and modernization initiatives.

Modernization Journey:
Be part of the transformation from legacy technologies toward modern .NET, AWS, cloud-native architectures, and scalable integrations.

Learning & Growth:
Expand your expertise across backend development, cloud technologies, architecture, integrations, and business-critical product configuration systems.

Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing:
Join a team that values collaboration, technical excellence, domain knowledge, and continuous improvement.

International Environment:
Work closely with stakeholders, architects, and developers from different countries and business areas in a truly international setup.

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion.

jobs.title: Microsoft Integration Consultant (Azure)
jobs.description:
You don’t just connect systems, you understand how integration drives real business impact.
As a Microsoft Integration Consultant
at delaware, you combine technical expertise with a consulting mindset. You’re comfortable designing integration landscapes, but you also know how to guide customers through decisions and trade-offs.
If you already have hands-on experience with Azure integration
and want to take the next step into more complex, high-impact environments, this role is built for you.

What will you be doing?

You’ll work as a consultant on integration projects for a wide range of customers, helping them modernize and connect their application landscape.
You will:
Design and implement scalable, secure, and high-performing integration solutions
on Microsoft Azure
Work with Azure Integration Services
(Logic Apps, API Management, Azure Functions, Data Factory, …)
Build and contribute to API-driven and microservices-based architectures

Take ownership from solution design to implementation and delivery

Contribute to both development and DevOps activities

Stay up to date with the Azure ecosystem and actively apply new capabilities in your projects
Act as a trusted advisor
for customers, translating technical solutions into business value

Who are we?

You’ll join our Microsoft Integration team
, a close-knit group of 30+ specialists who focus on connecting systems, data, and applications in a scalable way.
We combine deep technical expertise (Azure, .NET, APIs) with a strong consulting mindset. Knowledge sharing, continuous learning, and ownership are key in our team.
We don’t just deliver integration solutions, we help customers future-proof their application landscape.

Is there a match?

We’re looking for someone who already has a solid foundation in integration
and is ready to grow further.
You:

Have +5
years of experience with Azure integration technologies

(Logic Apps, API Management, Data Factory, Azure Functions, BizTalk, or similar)
Have working knowledge of .NET / C# / Typescript
or similar.
Understand integration patterns, APIs, and distributed systems
(or are eager to deepen this quickly)
Are comfortable in a customer-facing role
and communicate clearly
Speak Dutch and English fluently
(French is a plus)

👉 We are explicitly looking for candidates with hands-on Azure integration experience
, this is not an entry-level role.

What you can expect

Complex and varied projects where integration is business-critical
, not an afterthought
The opportunity to grow into roles such as Solution Architect or Integration Lead

A team where knowledge sharing and coaching
are part of the culture
The flexibility and trust that come with consultancy at delaware

Let's meet up

You’ll be part of a dynamic team that values collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning. We offer flexibility, growth opportunities, and the chance to work on impactful projects using leading-edge technologies.
Let’s connect to talk more about the job, your talents, your track record, and your future with the #peopleofdelaware!
